small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 16.6%: drop BLOCK_OC to 8 with BLOCK_SPATIAL=128 and pre-load the 3x3x3 weight tile per ic into registers once outside the kd/kh/kw loop. Move the bias add to the epilogue (after the ic loop) instead of initializing acc with it. Add num_stages=3 variants and a tiny config (BLOCK_OC=8,BLOCK_SPATIAL=64,num_warps=2) so the autotuner can find a higher-occupancy point.
large_guidance: Rewrite ConvTranspose3d as a scatter-style GEMM keyed on input voxels rather than the current gather: for each (n, ic-tile, input-spatial-tile) program, load x once and the weight tile [IC,OC,KD,KH,KW] once, compute the IC×OC outer product per (kd,kh,kw), and atomic/accumulate into the OD×OH×OW output. This removes the per-output-voxel divisibility branches (id%SD==0 etc.) which currently cause warp divergence and waste >7/8 of threads when stride=2. Alternatively, materialize an im2col view in channels_last layout and dispatch a tl.dot-based GEMM with BLOCK_M=64,BLOCK_N=64,BLOCK_K=32 to actually use tensor-core-friendly MMA instead of scalar FMAs (current kernel uses 220 regs/thread for hand-rolled FMAs). Fuse the BatchNorm affine (folded eval-time scale/shift) and mean-subtract into the conv epilogue so the output is written once.
